input.title: Reset a forgotten password
input.narrative: As a user, I want to reset my password so that I can regain access.
acceptance_criteria: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.
The same confirmation is shown for registered and unregistered emails.
The new password must satisfy the password policy.

test_cases.title: Registered user requests a password reset
test_cases.objective: Verify that a registered user can request a password-reset link.
preconditions: A registered account exists for user@example.com.

steps.action: Submit user@example.com from the forgot-password form.
steps.expected_result: A generic confirmation message is displayed.
A password-reset message containing a time-limited link is received.

source_requirements: A registered user receives a time-limited reset link.
